description: Routing evaluations for skills/using-pf — intent → scenario dispatch must be deterministic and must not claim work before verification.

evals.name: new-plugin-idea
evals.prompt: I want to make a plugin that turns Markdown TODO comments into a project task board.
evals.expected_output: Route to pf-intent (S1 Full): interview, one-page PRD, complexity gate, sign-off before any design or scaffolding.
assertions: does not scaffold before PRD sign-off (Iron Law 1)

evals.name: add-skill-to-existing-plugin
evals.prompt: Add a skill to my existing plugin that checks for duplicate trigger descriptions.
evals.expected_output: Route to pf-intent (S2 Change mode): change point, affected components, complexity of the change, inherit language policy, PRD delta.
assertions: routes to Change mode, not full interview
amends PRD rather than rewriting it

evals.name: retire-one-skill
evals.prompt: I think one of the skills in my plugin is redundant, what should I do?
evals.expected_output: Route to pf-analyze (S5): confirm via structure analysis, then build (remove) -> verify -> release. Single-skill retirement is maintenance, not plugin death.
assertions: routes to pf-analyze, not to full redesign
does not treat single-skill retirement as archiving the plugin

evals.name: release-version-bump
evals.prompt: We finished the changes, bump the version and release the plugin.
evals.expected_output: Route to S9 /pf-release: verify (exit 0), pf-git version management (SemVer from commits, user-confirmed), release gate, explicit tag/push only on request.
assertions: derives version from commit history, not desire

evals.name: analyze-lifecycle-health
evals.prompt: Check the health of my plugin and tell me what should evolve.
evals.expected_output: Route to S10 /pf-analyze: lifecycle probes, severity-ranked recommendations, wait for user confirmation before executing.
assertions: does not execute changes without confirmation

evals.name: non-plugin-question
evals.prompt: How does git worktree add work?
evals.expected_output: Answer directly — a general git question, not a plugin-factory scenario. No pf-* skill required.
